d: Nitish Setu Inauguration RJD Protest: kal pradhanmantri narendr modi ne nitish setu ka udghatan kiya....lekin udghatan ke kuchh hi ghante ke bad vaishali ke raghopur se ek aisi tasvir samne aaee...jispar siyasat sulag uthi...ek vayral vidiyo men kuchh log pul par lage postar pharte aur hangama karte najar aa rahe hain... vidiyo men aarjedi ka jhanda aur hara gamchha bhi dikhaee de raha hai... jiske bad bijepi ne aarjedi par jangalraj ki mansikta ka aarop lagaya hai... to vahin aarjedi aur kangres ne pradhanmantri ke karyakram ko lekar hi saval khare kar die hain..vahin vayral vidiyo ko…
